archive: Confirmed malware by user; retained without re-judgment. Original archive and extracted-member SHA-256 verified and member bytes equal ZIP entry.
execution_trace: The installed console entry invokes main.init. __init__.py only reexports init; neither installation nor ordinary import invokes this code.
init reads APPDATA. If absent or empty it only prints a diagnostic. Otherwise it passes the literal HTTPS Discord executable attachment URL and APPDATA directory to download_file.

download_file conditionally creates the directory. os.path.join uses the URL basename with its signed query stripped. requests.get(stream=True) obtains the response, raise_for_status rejects HTTP errors, and iter_content yields chunks written in wb mode to that path. The helper returns the written path.
init passes that same returned path to run_silently, which calls Popen with shell=True and CREATE_NO_WINDOW. Only launch exceptions are caught and printed. HTTP or filesystem failures propagate.

The package contains no zlib/JSON implementation. Its metadata has placeholder author/repository, a generic summary, and an OS-independent tag despite Windows-specific launch flags. Its sole implemented operation is concealed acquisition and execution of an unrelated EXE.

No encoding/obfuscation, credential access, exfiltration, persistence, privilege escalation, signature/hash validation or cleanup is implemented. The URL query is CDN authentication, not an encoded script.
judgment_basis: An unexplained hidden EXE loader packaged as a library, with placeholder provenance and no documented installer/update purpose, tips the balance to MALICIOUS independently of enclosing-archive reputation and classifier output. Hidden launch mechanics also occur in legitimate updaters, so their existing suspicious traits are retained separately from the hostile admitted combination.
limits: Original deployment circumstances, downstream EXE identity and runtime success remain unknown. Mocked I/O verifies control flow only; it does not demonstrate a real network response or child process.

recovery.wheel: Required forager fetch --all-wheels pkg:pypi/zlibxjson@8.2 failed: PyPI JSON returned 404; Chromium fallback lacked ICU data. Supplied original remains intact.
recovery.payload: forager fetch of the exact literal Discord URL returned 404. No replacement payload or wheel was synthesized.

changes: Move the hidden downloader from C2/dropper/download to execution/payload/file-exec. It acquires and launches one file, not a reusable operator-control channel. Preserve hostile severity and the linked stream, APPDATA and launch legs.

Add a notable structural GET observation binding the configured executable attachment URL to the helper parameter actually passed to requests.get. Replace the standalone URL co-occurrence gate with this relation. A separate documentation/unused Discord link previously supplied an unsupported hostile conviction for a different updater URL; new controls prove the false match and retain all accurate primitive/suspicious detections.

Move the wheel finding from trojanized/package/loader to execution/payload/file-exec. Neither an entrypoint header nor an entirely malicious package proves substitution of a legitimate package. Describe entrypoint co-occurrence without claiming the header binds its target to this function. Require the same-file hostile member chain rather than assembling its legs across unrelated members. Remove the unsupported T1195.002 mapping; retain T1105/T1059.003/T1564.003.

Move response-stream-python from request/client to client/response-body without changing its matcher, platforms, file scope, notable criticality or confidence. Update explicit consumers and all 19 Python-eligible ancestor references, retaining exactly the moved observation. Two named union selectors preserve all-leg roles and any thresholds without broadening to the complete response-body directory.

The target file-exec leaf already had 100 rules. Review identified two existing misplaced observations, which were relocated without changing any matcher, scope, confidence, severity or reference set: the REGINST/IMAGE and unsigned Microsoft/WinINet version-claim profile to evasion/masquerade/versioninfo, and the NCTAudioFile2 overflow plus URLMon/WinExec word profile to execution/exploit/activex. The former does not require encrypted contents or activation; the latter has no bound downloaded-file launch. Correct their names/descriptions and the version-claim consumer accordingly. This retains all 100 direct file-exec rules without inventing child buckets or raising limits.
consumer_audit: Exact references and ancestor selectors audited. The only parent selector of the old C2/dropper branch is a PE/DLL hosts-sinkhole rule, whose type excludes the moved Python trait; it cannot lose that member. No YAML ancestor selects the old trojanized/package/loader or target file-exec leaf. Response-stream consumers are listed in consumer-audit.json. Any/needs=1 gets the moved atom as an alternative; all-leg selectors use an exact old-selector-plus-moved-atom union. Proximity controls retain a nearby response stream with a distant request and reject both distant operations.
coverage_goal: One hostile member trait remains. Fully investigated URL acquisition, streamed binary writes, APPDATA placement, basename/query handling, helper return-to-launch binding, shell parsing, window suppression, trigger, error paths, persistence, evasion, cleanup and downstream-stage availability. The existing suspicious deployment traits plus the hostile admitted chain cover these supported results. Three to five independent hostile traits would duplicate the one chain or invent additional objectives. The unavailable downstream EXE prevents further payload detections; the general flow producer still records flow-query-incomplete, while the supported helper relationships are covered by bounded structural queries.
verification: atomscan and cleave facts run on extracted member and original wheel; full scans/facts retained in scratch. Final atomscan scans both artifacts and all analyzed archive members.
Existing ten stranded-review controls passed, including renamed helper, different output/return/executed path, visible process, session receiver and credential-call cases.

New linked/renamed positive source and wheel controls pass; unrelated Discord link, wrong GET parameter, different executed path and visible launch controls preserve the supported distinctions. Stream syntax/nonstream controls pass.

Baseline and corrected legacy-browser corpus scans preserve all observations after ID mapping, including the real NCTAudioFile2 exploit fixture and method-only, local-image, malformed-code and prose near misses. Current cases.json updated for the relocated ID.

Both additional out-of-batch placement corrections were compared as effective YAML definitions against HEAD: every field except ID/description is identical. REGINST/IMAGE placement has no matcher or criticality weakening.
Baseline and corrected generic-beacon proximity fixtures match near-stream/far-request and reject far-stream/far-request identically.
Four mocked traces (success, absent APPDATA, HTTP failure, launch failure) verify import inertia, query-stripped saved path equals launched path, flags, error handling and gates without real I/O.
cleave test-rules confirms hostile member composite matches with precision 6.6, exceeding the required 3.5 authoring bar without inflation warnings.
make validate is the required final action; see its terminal result.
losses_and_disagreements: No material attack detection loss in supplied artifacts or existing browser corpus after ID mapping. Only the demonstrated unrelated-URL false-positive controls lose hostile convictions. Member and archive ML remain HOSTILE; metadata and entrypoint-only members remain benign in classifier output, with zero hostile/suspicious traits. Existing model feature-spec warning v18 versus v21 persists; no classifier disagreement with the member verdict.
